12300.meaning1: condition for life; life force; vital power; motive force; (comm) life itself

examples.text: te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
yathā ca, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa javo yathā ca candimasūriyānaṃ javo yathā ca yā devatā candimasūriyānaṃ purato dhāvanti tāsaṃ devatānaṃ javo, tato sīghataraṃ āyusaṅkhārā khiyanti.

12301.meaning1: will to live; intention to exist
12301.commentary: (DNa) sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajī'ti satiṃ sūpaṭṭhitaṃ katvā ñāṇena paricchinditvā āyusaṅkhāraṃ vissajji, pajahi. tattha na bhagavā hatthena leḍḍuṃ viya āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji, temāsamattam'eva pana samāpattiṃ samāpajjitvā tato paraṃ na samāpajjissāmī'ti cittaṃ uppādesi. taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, ossajī'ti. ussajjī'ti pi pāṭho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji. ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.

12302.meaning1: giving up the will to live; relinquishing the intention to continue existing

examples.text: evam'eva kho, rājañña, yadā'yaṃ kāyo āyusahagato ca hoti usmāsahagato ca viññāṇasahagato ca, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca.

12305.meaning1: leading to long life; conducive to longevity

examples.text: āyusaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, vaṇṇasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, sukhasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, yasasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, saggasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, ādhipateyyasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitan'ti.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

12307.meaning1: leading to long life; conducive to longevity

examples.text: sappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ jānāti, pariṇatabhojī ca hoti, kālacārī ca hoti, brahmacārī ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā āyussā'ti.

12311.meaning1: discussion about the decrease of lifespan, appearance, etc.

12312.meaning1: discussion about the increase of lifespan, appearance, etc.

12314.meaning2: thrusts forward, pushes forward (intransitive); struggles, strains, exerts oneself (especially in water); pursues, works at

examples.text: te amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgate amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ gopako devaputto paṭicodesi, kutomukhā nāma tumhe, mārisā, tassa bhagavato dhammaṃ āyuhittha
yadākhv'āhaṃ, āvuso, santiṭṭhāmi tadāssu saṃsīdāmi, yadākhv'āhaṃ, āvuso, āyūhāmi tadāssu nibbuyhāmi. evaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, appatiṭṭhaṃ anāyūhaṃ ogham'atarin'ti.
n'atthi kiccaṃ brāhmaṇassa, katakicco hi brāhmaṇo, yāva na gādhaṃ labhati nadīsu, āyūhati sabbagattebhi jantu, gādhañ'ca laddhāna thale ṭhito yo, n'āyūhatī pāragato hi so'va.

12321.meaning1: striving; pushing forward; making an effort

examples.text: idāni tīsu'pi dvāresu āyūhanacetanā samodhānetabbā. seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadvāre sayaṃkatamūlikā vīsati cetanā, āṇattimūlikā vīsati, sampajānamūlikā vīsati, asampajānamūlikā vīsatī'ti asīti cetanā honti, tathā vacīdvāre.

12324.meaning1: striving; pushing forward; making an effort

12331.commentary: (ANt) apare pana purimehi vipākāvaraṇassa anuddhaṭattā tasmiṃ'y'eva khaṇe'ti ca avisesena vuttattā taṃ dosaṃ pariharituṃ āyūhitakammaṃ nāmā'ti-ādim'āha.

examples.text: tattha eke ācariyā yasmiṃ khaṇe kammaṃ āyūhati, tasmiṃ'y'eva khaṇe tassa saggo vārito'ti vadanti. apare pana āyūhitakammaṃ nāma vipākavāraṃ labhantam'pi atthi alabhantam'pi. tattha yadā kammaṃ vipākavāraṃ labhati, tasmiṃ'y'eva kāle tassa saggo vārito'ti vadanti.
anūpavādo anūpaghāto, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro, mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ, adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

12335.meaning1: (gram) āra; causative suffix added to nouns

examples.text: caggahaṇena āra āla'icc'ete paccayā honti. santaṃ karoti, santārati, upakkamaṃ karoti, upakkamālati.

sakkāyadiṭṭhi ārakā hoti, vicikicchā ārakā hoti, sīlabbataparāmāso ārako hoti, rāgo ārako hoti, doso ārako hoti, moho ārako hoti, māno ārako hoti. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ ārakattā arahā hotī'ti.

12339.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of āraka (+abl or +gen)
12339.construction:
ā + √ar + a + ka + ā
āraka + ā
12339.commentary: (MNa) ārakā ahaṃ, bhante'ti pathavito nabhaṃ viya samuddassa orimatīrato paratīraṃ viya ca suvidūravidūre ahaṃ.

examples.text: tapanīyāni kammāni, yāni dhammehi ārakā, tāni ārocayissāmi, taṃ suṇātha yathā tathaṃ.
seyyathā'pi allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ, ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbattessāmi, tejo pātukarissāmī'ti.

12340.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of āraka (+abl)
12340.construction:
ā + √ar + a + ka + ā
āraka + ā

examples.text: evañ'ce taṃ jano jaññā, yathā jānāmi taṃ ahaṃ, ārakā parivajjeyya, gūthaṭṭhānaṃ'va pāvuse.

12342.synonym: ārakkhaka, guttika, pāla, pālaka, rakkhaka, rakkhitar

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.

tassa heṭṭhā kumārassa sayanaṃ paññapetvā upari suvaṇṇatārakakhacitaṃ vitānaṃ bandhāpetvā sāṇipākārena parikkhipāpetvā ārakkhaṃ ṭhapetvā rājā sabb'ālaṅ'kāraṃ alaṅ'karitvā amaccagaṇaparivuto naṅgalakaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ agamāsi.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, ye'me pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me attarūpena appamādo sati cetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo.
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā taṃ ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti, tattha ca hoti adhuttī athenī asoṇḍī avināsikā.

12344.synonym: ārakkha, guttika, pāla, pālaka, rakkhaka, rakkhitar

12346.meaning1: ending of safeguarding; cessation of safekeeping
12346.meaning2: ending of safeguarding; cessation of safekeeping

examples.text: ārakkho ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso ārakkhe asati ārakkhanirodhā api nu kho daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhaveyyun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

tassa evaṃ ārakkhato gopayato te bhoge rājāno vā haranti, corā vā haranti, aggi vā dahati, udakaṃ vā vahati, appiyā vā dāy'ādā haranti. so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati, yam'pi me ahosi tam'pi no n'atthī'ti.

12348.meaning1: with mindfulness on guard; watched over by awareness

examples.text: etha tumhe, āvuso, indriyesu guttadvārā viharatha ārakkhasatino nipakkasatino, sārakkhitamānasā sat'ārakkhena cetasā samannāgatā'ti, iti indriyasaṃvare samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.

12350.commentary: (SNa) sati ārakkhasārathī'ti maggasampayuttā sati ārakkhasārathi. yathā hi rathassa ārakkho sārathi nāma yoggiyo. dhuraṃ vāheti yojeti akkhaṃ abbhañjati rathaṃ peseti rathayuttake nibbisevane karoti, evaṃ maggarathassa sati. ayañ'hi ārakkhapaccupaṭṭhānā c'eva kusal'ākusalānañ'ca dhammānaṃ gatiyo samanvesatī'ti vuttā. (SNt) pubbaṅ'gamabhāvena ārakkhaṃ sāretī'ti ārakkhasārathī. yathā hi rathassa… sārathī'ti vatvā taṃ dassetuṃ yoggiyo'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yassa saddhā ca paññā ca, dhammā yuttā sadā dhuraṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati ārakkhasārathi.

idha, bhante nāgasena, ācariyena antevāsimhi satataṃ samitaṃ ārakkhā upaṭṭhapetabbā, asevanasevanā jānitabbā, pamatt'āppamattā jānitabbā, seyyavakāso jānitabbo, gelaññaṃ jānitabbaṃ, bhojanassa laddh'āladdhaṃ jānitabbaṃ, viseso jānitabbo, pattagataṃ saṃvibhajitabbaṃ, assāsitabbo mā bhāyi

12353.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ārakkhādhikaraṇa (+gen)

examples.text: so tesaṃ bhogānaṃ ārakkh'ādhikaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, kin'ti me bhoge n'eva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāy'ādā hareyyun'ti

12355.meaning2: point of a needle or an awl

examples.text: vāri pokkharapatt'eva, ār'agge'r'iva sāsapo, yo na limpati kāmesu, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
yassa rāgo ca doso ca, māno makkho ca pātito, sāsapo'r'iva ār'aggā, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
tā kho pana, sāriputta, devatā dasa'pi hutvā vīsam'pi hutvā tiṃsam'pi hutvā cattālīsam'pi hutvā paññāsam'pi hutvā saṭṭhi'pi hutvā āraggakoṭinitudanamatte'pi tiṭṭhanti, na ca aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti.

12357.meaning2: arranging again and again; pulling this way and that

12358.commentary: (SNPa) jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ārajay'ārajayā vihanantī'ti tattha asipattavane vegena dhāvitvā patitānaṃ musāvādīnaṃ nerayikānaṃ nirayapālā jivhaṃ baḷisena nikkaḍḍhitvā yathā manussā allacammaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pattharitvā khilehi ākoṭenti, evaṃ ākoṭetvā pharasūhi phāletvā phāletvā ekam'ekaṃ koṭiṃ chindetvā vihananti, chinnachinnā koṭi punappunaṃ samuṭṭhāti. āracay'āracayā'ti'pi pāṭho, āviñchitvā āviñchitvā'ti attho. etam'pi devadūte avuttakammakāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: asipattavanaṃ pana tiṇhaṃ, taṃ pavisanti samucchidagattā, jivhaṃ balisena gahetvā, ārajay'ārajayā vihananti.

12359.commentary: (MNa) uccā ca dantehi ārañjitānī'ti satt'aṭṭharatan'ubbedhe vaṭarukkh'ādīnaṃ khandhappadese pharasunā pahataṭṭhānaṃ viya dāṭṭhāhi chinnaṭṭhānaṃ.

examples.text: so tam'anugacchati. tam'anugacchanto passati nāgavane mahantaṃ hatthipadaṃ, dīghato ca āyataṃ, tiriyañ'ca vitthataṃ, uccā ca nisevitaṃ, uccā ca dantehi ārañjitāni.

idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.

12361.meaning2: being in a forest, in the wild; forest-born, wild
12361.commentary: (SNa) āraññam'iva kuñjaran'ti yathā araññato pesitagaṇikārahatthiniyo āraññakaṃ kuñjaraṃ itthikuttadassanena palobhetvā bandhitvā ānayanti, evaṃ ānayissāma.

examples.text: ken'āsi dummano tāta, purisaṃ kaṃ nu socasi, mayaṃ taṃ rāgapāsena, āraññam'iva kuñjaraṃ, bandhitvā ānayissāma, vasago te bhavissatī'ti.

12362.meaning2: belonging to or living in a forest

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya
yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni sen'āsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni

12364.meaning1: fact of being a forest dweller
12364.meaning2: state of living in a forest
12364.construction:
√ar > ār + aṇa + ya + *ka + tta
āraññaka + tta

examples.text: te sen'āsane kalyāṇakāmā samānā riñcissanti āraññakattaṃ, riñcissanti araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni, gāmanigamarājadhānīsu osaritvā vāsaṃ kappessanti, sen'āsanahetu ca anekavihitaṃ anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjissanti.

12366.meaning2: belonging to or living in a forest
12366.commentary: (VINa) āraññiko hotī'ti gām'antasen'āsanaṃ paṭikkhipitvā āraññikadhut'aṅgavasena araññavāsiko hoti. (MNa) āraññiko'ti samādinnaāraññikadhutaṅgo.

examples.text: etha tumhe, āvuso, āraññikā hotha, araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevathā'ti, iti kāyavūpakāse samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso āraññiko hoti. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi āraññiko ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na āraññikā'ti. so tena āraññikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.

12367.meaning1: ascetic practice of living in the forest
12367.meaning2: practice of living in the wild
12367.commentary: (NIDD1a) āraññik'aṅgan'ti araññe nivāso sīlaṃ assā'ti āraññiko, tassa aṅgaṃ āraññik'aṅgaṃ. (VISM) āraññik'aṅgam'pi gām'antasen'āsanaṃ paṭikkhipāmi, āraññik'aṅgaṃ samādiyāmī'ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sambahulā bhikkhū santhatāni ujjhitvā āraññik'aṅgaṃ piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ samādiyiṃsu

aṭṭha dhut'aṅgāni, āraññik'aṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ, tecīvarik'aṅgaṃ, sapadānacārik'aṅgaṃ, khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ, nesajjik'aṅgaṃ, yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ, idaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.

12368.meaning1: fact of being a forest monk
12368.construction:
√ar > ār + aṇa + ya + *ika + tta
āraññika + tta

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso āraññiko hoti. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi āraññiko ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na āraññikā'ti. so tena āraññikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
so paṭipadaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ karitvā tena āraññikattena n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, sappurisadhammo.
evaṃ na katthati na vikatthati. katthanā ārato virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī'ti, iti'han'ti sīlesu akatthamāno.
āratī viratī pāpā, majjapānā ca saṃyamo, appamādo ca dhammesu, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

te upakaṭṭhāya vass'ūpanāyikāya pañcasatatāpase himavantato āgantvā nagare bhikkhāya carante disvā pasīditvā nisīdāpetvā bhojetvā paṭiññaṃ gahetvā cattāro māse attano santike vasāpetvā puna vassāratte āgaman'atthāya paṭijānāpetvā uyyojesuṃ.

yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathā vūpakaṭṭho viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ anussarati anuvitakketi, satisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, satisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
āraddhaṃ kho pana me, brāhmaṇa, vīriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ
catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti. katamehi catūhi?

12375.synonym: abhiraddha, tappita, titta, tuṭṭha, tuṭṭhi, patīta, santappita, santusita, santussita

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi, āraddho'smi, bhikkhave, imāya paṭipadāya, āraddhacitto'smi, bhikkhave, imāya paṭipadāya.

12376.synonym: attamana, abhiraddha, avighātavant, tuṭṭhi, dhāta, patītarūpa, pīṇa, sumana, summana, somanassajāta, somanassita

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi, āraddho'smi, bhikkhave, imāya paṭipadāya, āraddhacitto'smi, bhikkhave, imāya paṭipadāya.
catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. api ca m'ettha puggalavemattatā viditā'ti.

12380.meaning1: energetic (in); with energy aroused (to); applying energy (to); making an effort (to)

examples.text: sabbadā sīlasampanno, paññavā susamāhito, āraddhavīriyo pahit'atto, oghaṃ tarati duttaraṃ.
vīriyasambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā.

12381.meaning1: fact of being energetic; fact of having aroused energy; fact of making an effort

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, āraddhavīriyataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.

12383.notes: see SaDM 17 laddhā'ti labhitvā. laddhānā'ti labhitvāna. diṭṭhā'ti disvā

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde.

12386.grammar: ind, prep, ger of ārabhati, trans (+acc)
12386.meaning1: concerning; referring (to); regarding; at the expense (of); owing to

examples.text: atīte, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha.

12387.meaning1: begins; starts; initiates; undertakes; rouses oneself

examples.text: ārabbhatha nikkamatha, yuñjatha buddhasāsane, dhunātha maccuno senaṃ, naḷ'āgāraṃ'va kuñjaro.

12388.meaning1: fact of beginning; fact of undertaking; fact of initiation

examples.text: yaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, ārabbhadhātuyā sati ārabbhavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro ayaṃ parakāro.

upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu ārabbhamāno pajānāti cittañ'ca me suvimuttaṃ, thinamiddhañ'ca me susamūhataṃ, uddhaccakukkuccañ'ca me suppaṭivinītaṃ, āraddhañ'ca me vīriyaṃ, aṭṭhiṃkatvā manasi karomi, no ca līnanti.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, atthi ārabbhadhātū'ti? evaṃ, bho. ārabbhadhātuyā sati ārabbhavanto sattā paññāyantī'ti? evaṃ, bho. yaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, ārabbhadhātuyā sati ārabbhavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro ayaṃ parakāro.

12391.meaning1: begins; starts; undertakes; arouses oneself; makes an effort (to)

examples.text: kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilamissati. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti. so nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.
yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, kusīto hīnavīriyo, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, vīriyam'ārabhato daḷhaṃ.
tañ'ca pana ārabhantena paṭhamaṃ piyapuggal'ādīsu na ārabhitabbā. piyo hi piyaṭṭhāne'y'eva tiṭṭhati. atippiyasahāyako atippiyasahāyakaṭṭhāne'y'eva.
bhikkhū kattaradaṇḍe ca ukkāyo ca gahetvā mocessāmā'ti anubandhiṃsu. byaggho bhikkhūnaṃ agatiṃ chinnataṭaṭṭhānam'āruyha taṃ bhikkhuṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakato paṭṭhāya khādituṃ ārabhi.
